info.name: SOOQ
info.description:
Complete API collection for ShopEngine e-commerce platform.

**Setup:** Merchant: Request OTP (optional `X-Tenant-Slug` for returning login) → Verify OTP → GET Store Settings (`isConfigured`) → PUT Store Settings (`storeName`, `slug`, `primaryCurrencyCode`) + optional branding; slug check via GET `/admin/store/settings/check-slug`. **Merchant OTP:** one store per owner phone is stored on `tenant.owner_phone`; omit `X-Tenant-Slug` to resolve by phone (or provision). Tokens refresh via Refresh Token. Customer: Customer Request OTP (needs tenant) → Customer Verify OTP. STR store settings now update the existing tenant config row only and expose a persisted `configured` flag after the merchant supplies store identity details. Variables update automatically where scripts are attached.

**Modules:** AUTH, STR (Store Settings), PRD (Product), ORD (Order), PAY (Payment), SHP (Shipping), APP (Mobile App Builder)

**Product Create/Update**: uses multipart/form-data — `product` part holds the JSON body (Content-Type: application/json), `files` part holds optional images.

Last updated: 2026-05-14

header.description: Omit to resolve tenant by owner phone (one store per phone); set to log into a specific store by slug.

request.description: Requires OWNER, MANAGER, or PLATFORM_ADMIN. All query params optional.
Requires Bearer token with role OWNER or MANAGER. Returns boolean in standard envelope.

Multipart upload (Content-Type set automatically). `files` is an array; one file is fine. Response.data[0] is the asset UUID — use its URL in **`PUT /admin/store/settings`** `logoUrl`. Requires Bearer JWT for the authenticated merchant.

Send storeName + slug + primaryCurrencyCode together to finish onboarding (`configured=true`). `themeCode` selects the storefront template (FE registry key — lowercase, hyphenated; FE falls back to `default` on unknown values). Requires JWT role OWNER or MANAGER.

status ∈ {ACTIVE, MAINTENANCE, PASSWORD_PROTECTED, PAUSED, CLOSED}. `maintenanceMessage` is shown to customers when MAINTENANCE/PAUSED. `storePassword` (4-100 chars) is required when status=PASSWORD_PROTECTED.

item.name: Admin - Product Attributes (EAV)

item.name: RET (Returns)
item.description: Sprint 9 — Customer-initiated returns + merchant approval/rejection workflow (RET-001/RET-002/RET-003). Phase 1 ships create + list + get for both surfaces; Phase 2 adds approve/reject.

request.description: Customer submits a return for a DELIVERED order. reason ∈ {DEFECTIVE, WRONG_ITEM, CHANGED_MIND, DOESNT_FIT, OTHER}. customReasonText is required if and only if reason=OTHER. Each item.quantity must be ≤ the corresponding order_item.quantity. 201 with the persisted return (status=PENDING). Publishes ReturnRequestCreatedEvent → customer email + merchant bell-icon.
Paged list scoped to the authenticated customer, sorted by requestedAt DESC.
Returns 404 if the request is not owned by the authenticated customer (no cross-customer visibility).
Merchant admin paged list, scoped to the current tenant. Optional status + reason filters power the RET-002 analytics view (drop either query param to skip the filter). Roles: OWNER, MANAGER, STAFF.
Returns 404 if the request belongs to a different tenant. Roles: OWNER, MANAGER, STAFF.

Approves the return all-or-nothing. Refund = Σ(orderItem.unitPrice × returnItem.quantity). Async fan-out (AFTER_COMMIT): PAY initiates refund, PRD restores inventory per line, ORD transitions order DELIVERED → RETURNED, NTF emails the customer. Refund failures (e.g. COD orders) are logged and do NOT roll back the approval. Roles: OWNER, MANAGER (STAFF cannot approve).
Stores rejectionReason and notifies the customer. Terminal — customer must resubmit a new return if they want a different outcome. Roles: OWNER, MANAGER.
